title: settings.v1: a person's own settings, the file $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/recursion/settings.toml
description: The shape of the TOML file once it is parsed. One owner-only file of the person's own; the core reads it (recursion_core/settings.py) and nothing of the product writes it. Every setting has a default, so the file and every key in it may be absent. The list of settings is append-only: a later version adds properties and never renames or removes one. A key this version does not declare is reported by the reader (settings_unknown_key) and skipped, so additional properties are allowed here. A value of the wrong type or outside minimum and maximum keeps the default (settings_value_out_of_range). Each leaf's 'default' and 'description' are those of the reader's table. The settings file reader accepts version only as a TOML integer (a whole number such as 1) and rejects a float such as 1.0.

version.description: JSON Schema cannot tell 1.0 from 1, so this schema accepts version 1.0; the reader takes only the whole number 1 and refuses 1.0 (settings_unreadable), keeping every default.

gil_check.description: Whether each plugin host makes its GIL check; on by default, and a person may turn it off.
